description: Symptom-to-cause-to-fix mapping. Used by the voice agent to route a user complaint to the right diagnostic path. Order: try the top cause first before moving down.

failures.symptom_sv: Tät, klibbig krumma, små jämna hål
failures.symptom_en: Tight, gummy crumb with small even bubbles

causes_ranked.evidence: Rise under 50 %, no visible big bubbles in dough
causes_ranked.fix: Push bulk 60–90 min longer next time, or raise DDT by 2 °C

causes_ranked.evidence: Surface was tight at shape, dough felt deflated
causes_ranked.fix: Preshape gentler, final shape with less aggressive tension

causes_ranked.evidence: Starter took >8 h to peak at 1:5:5
causes_ranked.fix: Double-feed starter same temperature for 2 builds before bake

failures.symptom_sv: Blöt, seg mittenbit även när brödet är kallt
failures.symptom_en: Wet, shiny, gummy center after cooling

causes_ranked.evidence: Internal temp under 96 °C, loaf still warm inside when sliced
causes_ranked.fix: Bake 5–10 min longer or +10 °C on phase 2. Always cool 45 min before cutting.

causes_ranked.evidence: Tight crumb AND wet center
causes_ranked.fix: Longer bulk AND longer bake

failures.symptom_sv: Platt bröd, spred ut sig på plåten

causes_ranked.evidence: Final proof poke test stayed indented, dough felt slack
causes_ranked.fix: Shorten final proof, or reduce bulk by 10 % next time

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf looked slack on the couche/banneton before bake
causes_ranked.fix: Tighter final shape with more surface tension

causes_ranked.evidence: Dough tore when stretched during folds
causes_ranked.fix: One extra early fold, or longer mixer time speed 2

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf pulled at 30 min total, phase 2 under 10 min
causes_ranked.fix: Extend phase 2 by 5–10 min or +10 °C

causes_ranked.evidence: Also very open/wild crumb, sour taste
causes_ranked.fix: Shorter bulk next time

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf leathery and damp surface at end of bake
causes_ranked.fix: Dual-oven transfer or vent steam oven before phase 2

failures.symptom_sv: Baguetten har inga ordentliga öron, bara ytliga snitt
failures.symptom_en: Baguette scored but no ear, just shallow cuts

causes_ranked.evidence: Cuts were perpendicular to surface (90°) or axis (90°)
causes_ranked.fix: 30° blade angle, cuts near-parallel to loaf axis (10–20°)

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf had been out of fridge >10 min before scoring
causes_ranked.fix: Score straight from fridge

causes_ranked.evidence: Crust set fast, no pliability window
causes_ranked.fix: Use cold-start medium steam 180 °C for phase 1

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf slumped during transfer
causes_ranked.fix: Shorter bulk or shorter retard

failures.symptom_sv: Spricker upp på sidan i stället för på snittet
failures.symptom_en: Side blowout instead of clean score opening

causes_ranked.evidence: Score less than 5 mm deep
causes_ranked.fix: Score 10 mm deep at 30°

causes_ranked.evidence: Loaf was shaped with weak seam sealing
causes_ranked.fix: Seam DOWN at load, press seam firmly during shape

causes_ranked.evidence: Tight crumb and blowout together
causes_ranked.fix: Longer bulk, longer final proof

causes_ranked.cause: Phase 2 too long or too hot
causes_ranked.evidence: Phase 2 >20 min at 230+ °C
causes_ranked.fix: Drop phase 2 by 5 min or 10 °C

causes_ranked.evidence: Dough hydration under 75 %
causes_ranked.fix: Higher hydration gives thinner, crispier crust

failures.symptom_en: Boule with tight, even crumb (wanted open)

causes_ranked.evidence: Rise under 60 %
causes_ranked.fix: Push bulk to 75–85 % rise

causes_ranked.evidence: Folded in the last 90 min of bulk
causes_ranked.fix: No folds in final third of bulk

causes_ranked.evidence: Tall loaf, fine crumb
causes_ranked.fix: Shape with less aggressive tension

causes_ranked.evidence: Under 78 %
causes_ranked.fix: Raise hydration to 82 %

causes_ranked.evidence: Used wheat flour
causes_ranked.fix: Use rice flour — doesn't absorb water

causes_ranked.evidence: >14 h at 3 °C
causes_ranked.fix: Shorter cold retard

failures.symptom_sv: Surdegen är slö, peakar sent, tripplar inte
failures.symptom_en: Starter sluggish, peaks late or low

causes_ranked.evidence: Room temp under 21 °C
causes_ranked.fix: Warm spot — 24–26 °C for builds

causes_ranked.evidence: Strong vinegar smell, dark hooch
causes_ranked.fix: Reset: 1:10:10 twice daily for 2 days, warm

causes_ranked.evidence: Same behavior on fresh flour is better
causes_ranked.fix: New bag of flour, preferably freshly milled

failures.symptom_sv: Tät, tung botten men luftig topp

causes_ranked.evidence: Pale, soft bottom crust
causes_ranked.fix: Preheat stone/tray longer, pull parchment at phase 2

causes_ranked.evidence: Bottom damp after cooling
causes_ranked.fix: Always cool on wire rack
